title: Buying new things feels wonderful. But it can also be a trap
summary: Constantly buying new things can be problematic, says journalist Eric Athas, author of the new book "Saying No to New." Here's how to break the cycle and find joy in what you already have.
contentText:
Saying No to New , says that "you do feel joy and excitement" from buying new things initially — "but science says those feelings can't last."'/> Constantly buying new things can be problematic, says journalist Eric Athas, author of the new book "Saying No to New." Here's how to break the cycle and find joy in what you already have.
